title: check_registry is one 760-line function of closures
description:
git-vouch:1341-2100. check_registry holds the whole trust model in one function: about 25 nested closures (record_at, keys_at, adding, is_signed, owners, check_signer, may_grant, lowered, judge, judge_tier, standing, tier_ends, anchor_ends, judge_endorsement, endorsed_at, held_at...). They share and mutate local dicts (people, which loses claimants at 1623; signed, judged, stood), and held_at escapes in CheckResult with all of that captured.

What goes wrong if it stays: kernel reviewers cannot review one phase without holding all 760 lines in mind. No phase can be unit-tested on its own, so every test builds a whole registry, which is part of why the suite is slow. Phase order is implicit: the revocation pass at 1627 relies on owns() over the key-ownership state built at 1555-1625, and tier judging relies on revoked. A contributor reordering blocks gets no error.

Fix: no new abstractions needed. Turn the phases already marked by comments into module-level functions that pass their inputs explicitly: _load_records (1390-1425), _person_continuity (1443-1535), _key_owners (1555-1625), _revocations (1627-1700), _warn_unchained (1702-1733), tiers (check_signer through tier_ends), endorsements (1975-2005), and keep held_at as the one closure. An alternative is one small class whose memo dicts are attributes. Either way, each phase's inputs show up in its signature.
notes: check_registry split into module functions _load_records, _person_continuity, _key_owners, _revocations, _warn_unchained, _judge_tiers, _ended, _endorsed, _exported_emails, _warn_migrated, _endorsed_at; history readers _record_at/_person_at/_keys_at/_anchors_at/_pair_at/_adding; mutually recursive tier judges + memos in class _Judge. Remaining closures: held_at (returned in CheckResult) and, inside _key_owners, is_signed/first_current/owners/owns over that phase's private memo dicts; owns is passed to _revocations explicitly, so phase order is in the signatures. Full suite identical (1332 passed, 40 skipped, 3.12 and 3.9).
close_reason: check_registry split into phase functions and class _Judge; behaviour-preserving, full suite 1332 passed/40 skipped on 3.12 and 3.9
